text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I won?! Me... 
against McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No way... It's not a lie, right...? Is it?

A heartfelt scream echoed across the 
autumn sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Good grief... You are getting far too 
carried away, Ryan."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the possibility of this happening 
was always there, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is simply that you did not believe in 
yourself. Nothing more, nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. The only reason I 
couldn't win for so long was because 
McQueen was just that strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I don't think this single race 
settles anything between us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Of course. Who would acknowledge someone 
after just one time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right? Next up is... the Arima Kinen, I 
guess. If only I can enter!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, you certainly are impatient... You 
went through the trouble of beating me, so 
do savor the afterglow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, farewell. Today's race was 
merely the opening act.
choice_data_list:
When you say the curtain rises... do you 
mean for the real battle?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of Ryan and myself— the Mejiro Golden Age, 
that is!

And so, her first showdown with Mejiro 
McQueen came to an end, yielding great 
results for Mejiro Ryan.

And the road stretches even further. To 
the end-of-year "Arima Kinen," where 
formidable, unknown rivals await.
